prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> Futuristic running shoe in three-quarter front-lateral profile, suspended above ground, toe pointing down and right. Mint-teal knit upper with hexagonal perforations, ribbed sock-like collar with internal heel pull tab, sculpted white foam midsole with biomimetic cell-like surface, translucent structural heel counter, cage-style lacing with crossing midfoot laces, dark rubber outsole. Generic biomimetic concept shoe; no brand logo, three-stripe marking, or wordmark appears. Source: <Picture 1>.

<Picture 1> Static product reference photo of <Subject 1> against warm orange-to-burnt-orange gradient with soft horizontal shadow band near upper third. Same three-quarter front-lateral angle, centered portrait frame. Composition anchor.

summary:
[reference generation] Speculative_System_Montage_H3 product concept video using the reference photograph as the only core product anchor. The shoe's silhouette, structural geometry, layered materials, and three-quarter suspended pose are strictly preserved; brand-specific surface markings are not displayed. A 15-second high-contrast B&W montage cycles through black-screen startup, silhouette reveal, material macro, structural scan, layer separation, exploded view, material transition, blueprint wireframe, particle reconstruction, rapid recap, and final hero lockup. Mint-teal appears at full saturation only at the opening silhouette and final hero lockup; intermediate stages are minimalist B&W high-contrast.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> fully_preserved — composition anchor and canonical pose, lighting angle, material layering, mint-teal color reference for the entire sequence.
<Subject 1> fully_preserved — profile, knit texture, midsole, cage, heel counter, outsole, three-quarter angle stay identical to <Picture 1> in every shot showing the shoe.

detailed_description:
Premium technology product advertising montage in minimalist black-and-white motion design combining biomimetic materials, HUD scanning, material macro, exploded layering, blueprint wireframe, and particle reconstruction. Lightweight technical UI is a peripheral layer with no readable text. Mint-teal color is held only at the opening silhouette and final hero lockup; intermediate stages desaturate to strict B&W high-contrast.

[Shot 1] Static black frame. Faint white crosshair and thin white bounding rectangle draw into center; subtle film grain and a soft scan line drift.

[Shot 2] At 00:00.500, cut to a hard-edged silhouette of <Subject 1> against pure black, identical in profile, scale, and three-quarter pose to <Picture 1>. The shoe retains mint-teal knit, white midsole, dark outsole at this single beat. Thin white measurement bracket and three crosshair markers around toe, midfoot, heel.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.500, push in toward the lateral midfoot. Surface desaturates to a B&W macro of the knit upper. Threads, hexagonal perforations, woven texture appear in monochrome close-up. A thin white HUD ring orbits the focal area with a short measurement scale along the lower edge.

[Shot 4] At 00:04.500, dolly laterally across the shoe in monochrome. Bright white HUD scanning grid sweeps from heel to toe, projecting thin contour lines, dotted markers, and a faint horizontal cross-section plane through the midsole foam. Each structural layer (outsole, midsole, heel counter, knit upper, cage) is briefly highlighted by a thin white outline.

[Shot 5] At 00:06.500, hold a static three-quarter view. The shoe separates vertically into four thin floating layers — dark rubber outsole, white foam midsole, structural heel cage, knit upper — each hovering slightly above the next with a thin white shadow line, all monochrome. Two thin white measurement arrows from a side HUD bracket indicate layer thickness.

[Shot 6] At 00:08.500, pull back and rotate slowly to a higher three-quarter angle. The four floating layers push outward into a wider exploded view, drifting apart along the vertical axis while remaining aligned to the original pose. A thin white isometric wireframe of the shoe's negative space appears between layers; four white trajectory lines extend downward from each layer into a faint ground grid.

[Shot 7] At 00:10.000, hold a close three-quarter view. The white foam midsole transitions into a biomimetic micro-structure: thousands of small white hexagonal cells populate the midsole from heel to forefoot, then dissolve back into smooth foam. Monochrome white-on-black with soft inner glow; silhouette and pose of <Subject 1> stay recognizable.

[Shot 8] At 00:11.500, cut to a full-frame blueprint wireframe of <Subject 1> in white-on-black line art, matching the original three-quarter pose. Contour lines, lacing pattern, midsole grooves, and outsole tread drawn as thin strokes. Wireframe rotates ten degrees around the vertical axis and back. No labels or text.

[Shot 9] At 00:12.500, hold a static three-quarter view. Small white particles converge from the four edges toward center, gradually reconstructing the silhouette of <Subject 1>. As particles settle, the mint-teal knit color fades back into the upper, and the white foam midsole, dark outsole, and structural cage re-materialize, settling into the exact suspended pose of <Picture 1>.

[Shot 10] At 00:13.500, rapid one-second recap: three flash cuts — brief silhouette outline, brief knit weave macro, brief exploded-layer view — each held roughly a third of a second against black with a thin frame border.

[Shot 11] At 00:14.000, cut to the final hero lockup. <Subject 1> is suspended in the original three-quarter pose from <Picture 1>, fully rendered with mint-teal knit upper, white foam midsole, dark outsole, and structural cage, against a soft gradient from deep charcoal at top to lighter charcoal at bottom. Thin white measurement bracket to the lower left, small crosshair to the upper right. The shoe holds this pose with subtle floating micro-motion until the end.

overall_soundscape:
Near-silent open with faint low-frequency hum and a subtle electronic tick on each scan pulse. Silhouette reveal adds a soft high-frequency shimmer that swells and decays. Macro and scan beats carry dry synthetic clicks, faint electronic whirr, paper-rustle textures. Exploded view and midsole transition introduce a low resonant thrum and soft crystalline taps as cells populate. Blueprint wireframe is silent except for a quiet sine drone. Particle reconstruction carries soft granular hiss and gentle chime-like settling. Recap produces three percussive snaps; hero lockup closes with a sustained low pad fading. No voices, no dialogue, no lyrics.

non_diegetic_music:
Continuous cinematic electronic cue beneath the full 15 seconds. Sparse analog synth pads, soft filtered pulse patterns, faint glassy arpeggios sustain a slow tempo, peaking once during the exploded view and once during particle reconstruction before settling into a minimal held chord for the hero lockup. No lyrics, no vocals.
